regime_context: China A-shares are in a narrow, two-theme tape: Banks clearly lead (score 0.998, durability 0.73, crowded) with Innovative Pharma & CXO close behind (0.988, also crowded), while only 4 of 22 themes pass the absolute-trend gate. The detector's own backtest says the trend gate did NOT cut drawdown on this market's history (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), so everything here is display-grade focus/flow texture, not a validated edge — and my own 0.377 directional accuracy over 77 calls says I should default to low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether AI Compute & Optics (rank 3, score 0.682, breadth 0.059, currently trend-gate ineligible) regains eligibility and breadth above ~0.3 while Banks' durability bar drops below ~0.6 — that would be a confirmed, observable handoff worth re-reading; until then it is just a weak, narrow trend.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the clear, durable leader by both rank (0.998) and durability (0.73), with strong breadth (0.889). But the trend gate has no validated drawdown edge on this market, and the theme is crowded (z=1.78). The lean is a modest directional preference toward the dominant, coherent theme, sized-down in spirit given crowding — not a forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding marks tops late in a mean-reverting A-share tape, and gate_helps=false means the trend discipline never paid here — the leader may simply be the last leg of a value rotation that reverses quickly.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms the CSI 300 by 5% before the 21-day check-by date

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors rank only 8th (0.315) but are still trend-gate eligible, with weak breadth (0.091) and a low durability bar (0.54) relative to its trend tag. On a tape where the gate has no validated edge, an eligible-but-narrow trend theme is not a strong hold; lean underweight while it lacks cohesion.
evidence: crowding_z -0.15 (not crowded, so this is a breadth/durability read, not a fade)
theses.dissent: A narrow trend theme with eligible status can run hard on idiosyncratic news flow in A-shares, and the gate not helping cuts both ways — it may still grind up on momentum while the broad market churns.

falsifier.text: 512760.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by 5% before the 21-day check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the closest challenger (0.988, margin only 0.01 to Banks), eligible and durable (0.60), but crowded (z=1.59) and with moderate breadth (0.643). Rotation breadth is narrow (0.18 eligible) and absorption sits at 0.32, so this is a two-theme market — leaning overweight on the second leg of the concentrated pair, again sized down for crowding.
theses.dissent: Both leaders are crowded simultaneously — a sign of a complacent, narrow tape. If the A-share market mean-reverts as the backtest implies, the two crowded leaders are the most at risk together, not a diversified bet.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ underperforms the CSI 300 by 5% before the 21-day check-by date
